note: 每日马股速报。每天由排程任务根据公开新闻整理，摘要为 12Invest 自行撰写，每条附来源。

days.title: 马股微涨0.14%，银行股撑盘；IOI 旗下 REIT 定价96仙，11月25日上主板

market.note: 银行股走强带动指数小涨：马银行、联昌及大众银行皆起，兴业银行与大马银行涨21仙；国能与 IHH 则拖累指数。下跌股多于上涨股，大市情绪偏谨慎。

items.title: IOIPG Malaysia REIT 定价每单位96仙，筹资约 RM2.1 billion
items.text: IOI Properties 旗下的 IOIPG Malaysia REIT 发售最多22亿个单位，以每单位 RM0.96 计筹资约 RM2.1 billion，预计11月25日在主板挂牌。零售部分共约7.16亿单位，其中1.1亿单位开放给大马公众。这是大马至少13年来最大的 REIT 上市。

items.title: Advance Technologies Asia 签署包销协议，筹备上 ACE
items.text: 机电工程方案商 Advance Technologies Asia（ATA）将发行1.036亿新股（占扩大后股本22.82%），另献售1,740万旧股，其中2,270万股开放给大马公众，由 Malacca Securities 包销。公司正扩展数据中心运营与维护业务。

items.title: ISF Group 获4份数据中心合约共 RM83.2m
items.text: ISF Group 拿下波德申一座超大规模数据中心的4份合约，总值 RM83.2 million，未入账订单增至 RM225.5 million。

items.title: Econpile 获东禅医院 RM73m 打桩工程
items.text: Econpile 获颁吉隆坡东禅医院新大楼的打桩与地下结构工程，合约值 RM73 million，工期21个月。

items.title: Signature Alliance 获浮罗交怡海底世界翻新工程
items.text: Signature Alliance Group 获 RM51.56 million 合约，重建与翻新浮罗交怡海底世界，工程11月13日起为期18个月。

items.title: Northern Solar 获两项数据中心绿电供应
items.text: Northern Solar 在企业再生能源供应计划下获两项项目，为数据中心供应合共189MWac太阳能并配备储能。

items.title: Pekat 斥资 RM30.58m 购入汝来工业地
items.text: Pekat Group 以 RM30.58 million 收购汝来6块工业地，扩充开关设备、电池储能、变压器与变电站业务。

items.title: Dialog 扩建丹绒浪莎油库
items.text: Dialog 将在柔佛丹绒浪莎油库增加10万立方米储量，预计2029年中总储量突破110万立方米。

en.title: KLCI edges up 0.14% on banks; IOI's REIT priced at 96 sen, lists on Main Market on 25 Nov
en.note: Gains in banking stocks lifted the index: Maybank, CIMB and Public Bank rose, while RHB Bank and AMMB each added 21 sen; Tenaga and IHH weighed on the benchmark. Decliners outnumbered gainers, a sign of cautious sentiment.

items.title: IOIPG Malaysia REIT priced at RM0.96 a unit, raising about RM2.1 billion
items.text: IOI Properties' IOIPG Malaysia REIT is offering up to 2.2 billion units at RM0.96 each to raise about RM2.1 billion, with a Main Market listing expected on 25 November. The retail portion totals about 716 million units, including 110 million units for the Malaysian public. It is Malaysia's largest REIT listing in at least 13 years.

items.title: Advance Technologies Asia signs underwriting deal ahead of ACE listing
items.text: M&E engineering solutions provider Advance Technologies Asia (ATA) will issue 103.6 million new shares (22.82% of the enlarged share capital) and offer 17.4 million existing shares; 22.7 million shares go to the Malaysian public, underwritten by Malacca Securities. The company is expanding its data-centre operations and maintenance business.

items.title: ISF Group wins four data-centre contracts worth RM83.2m
items.text: ISF Group secured four contracts for a hyperscale data centre in Port Dickson worth a combined RM83.2 million, lifting its unbilled order book to RM225.5 million.

items.title: Econpile lands RM73m piling job for Tung Shin Hospital
items.text: Econpile won the piling and substructure works for a new Hospital Tung Shin building in Kuala Lumpur, worth RM73 million over 21 months.

items.title: Signature Alliance to refurbish Underwater World Langkawi
items.text: Signature Alliance Group secured a RM51.56 million contract to redevelop and refurbish Underwater World Langkawi, with 18 months of works starting 13 November.

items.title: Northern Solar wins two green-power supply awards for data centres
items.text: Northern Solar received two awards under the corporate renewable energy supply scheme to supply a combined 189MWac of solar power with battery storage to data centres.

items.title: Pekat buys Nilai industrial land for RM30.58m
items.text: Pekat Group is acquiring six industrial parcels in Nilai for RM30.58 million to expand its switchgear, battery storage, transformer and substation businesses.

items.title: Dialog expands Tanjung Langsat terminal
items.text: Dialog is adding 100,000 cubic metres of storage at its Tanjung Langsat terminal in Johor, taking total capacity above 1.1 million cubic metres by mid-2029.
